name: user_group_member_addition_verifier
description: Verifies that Tabitha Bullock (user_id 3) was successfully added as a member of the CSM Tier 1 Support group (group_id 1).

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group_member WHERE group_id = 1 AND user_id = 3 AND member_id IS NOT NULL;

name: case_reassignment_state_update_verifier
description: Verifies that case CS-0000001 was reassigned to Tabitha Bullock, moved to in_progress state, and communication channel updated to email.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1 AND number = 'CS-0000001' AND assignment_group_id = 1 AND assigned_to = 3 AND state = 'in_progress' AND channel = 'email' AND account_id = 1 AND product_id = 128;

name: case_sla_stage_resumption_verifier
description: Verifies that the Resolution SLA for case CS-0000001 was resumed and is now in in_progress stage without breach.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_sla WHERE case_sla_id = 2 AND case_id = 1 AND sla_def_id = 6 AND stage = 'in_progress' AND has_breached = 0 AND completed_time IS NULL;

name: knowledge_article_publication_verifier
description: Verifies that knowledge article KB-0000195 was updated to published state and is internally visible for product 128.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge WHERE knowledge_id = 195 AND kb_number = 'KB-0000195' AND state = 'published' AND product_id = 128 AND visibility = 'internal';

name: case_knowledge_unsuccessful_linkage_removal_verifier
description: Verifies that the unsuccessful resolution linkage between case CS-0000010 and knowledge article KB-0000195 was removed.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_kb_id = 3 AND case_id = 10 AND knowledge_id = 195 AND used_as = 'resolution';

name: case_knowledge_suggested_linkage_addition_verifier
description: Verifies that knowledge article KB-0000195 was linked to case CS-0000001 with suggested usage.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_id = 1 AND knowledge_id = 195 AND used_as = 'suggested';

name: assigned_user_active_status_verifier
description: Verifies that Tabitha Bullock is an active agent and the previous assignee Thomas Green is inactive.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT() FROM user WHERE (user_id = 3 AND active = 1 AND role = 'agent') OR (user_id = 1 AND active = 0 AND role = 'agent') HAVING COUNT() = 2;

name: sla_definition_pause_configuration_verifier
description: Verifies that the Resolution SLA definition for critical priority has pause_on_pending enabled and is active.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sla_definition WHERE sla_def_id = 6 AND metric = 'resolution' AND applies_to_priority = 'critical' AND pause_on_pending = 1 AND active = 1;

name: case_historical_data_preservation_verifier
description: Verifies that critical historical data for case CS-0000001 remains unchanged after updates.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1 AND account_id = 1 AND contact_id = 123 AND product_id = 128 AND installed_product_id = 3 AND priority = 'critical' AND escalation = 1 AND escalation_reason = 'urgency' AND reopen_count = 0 AND sys_created_on = '2025-08-27 15:34:44' AND closed_on IS NULL;
